title: The Ultimate Electrician’s Guide to Google Local Services Ads

facts.fact: The page states that Google Local Services Ads for electricians are billed per lead generated rather than per click.
facts.quote: electricians don’t pay for every click their ad gets but rather every lead their ad generates

facts.fact: The page states that Local Services Ads are shown as several paid ads above the organic results when a user searches for a relevant keyword such as 'electrician near me'.
facts.quote: Google triggers Local Services Ads and shows several paid ads on top of the organic SERPs relevant to the (relevant keyword).
